evidence: The continuous downscaling of complementary metal oxide semiconductor devices demands the introduction of dielectric layers with a high permittivity. Three-dimensional transistor structures, such as FinFET devices, require excellent step coverage by the high- material as provided by atomic layer deposition . In addition, because of the 3D structure, surfaces with different crystallographic orientation need to be covered. Because the initial HfO 2 deposition using ALD HfCl 4 /H2O is governed by the OH surface density, we investigated its dependence on the crystallographic orientation of the silicon substrate.
